content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it is possible to operate a [product_name] [version_no] using a mobile app over a local Ethernet connection. Also, is there any mobile app that allows control of [product_name] [version_no] from any location? If there are any available options, please provide guidance on how to set this up.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Are you referring to [version_no] ([article_no])? If so, and you only want to connect to [product_name] on your local network, you can use the integrated web server. There are two types of web servers available on [product_name] [version_no]: a basic and an extended web server. Both allow you to control the device.
